name: His Golden Shield
game_text: Spot 3 <culture>Rohan</culture> Men to make an opponent remove <twilight>1</twilight> or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck. Do this once for each card in that player's hand when you play this event.
flavor_text: “...even as Oromë the Great in the battle of the Valar when the world was young.”
